title: Example worker backlog
description: Fictional example of the Example Scheduler, a made-up job scheduler; not a description of any real system.

entities.title: Alarm on failed runs
entities.summary: Raise an alarm to the operator on duty when a run fails.
entities.details: Every failed run raises one alarm, naming the job, the slot and the error. Repeated failures of one job within an hour are grouped.

entities.title: Leases expire under long runs
entities.summary: A run longer than the lease lets a second worker claim the slot.
entities.expected: A running job keeps its lease until it finishes.
entities.observed: The lease expires after ten minutes, whatever the run is doing.
reproduction: Schedule a job that sleeps for fifteen minutes
